description: Small frames extracted from official mascot artwork for local SwiftBar playback.
processing: Cropped transparency, resized with nearest-neighbor sampling into 40x28 RGBA cells, and losslessly compressed. Claude left walking mirrors its original frames. Codex uses distinct original left and right frames.
rights: Artwork remains attributable to Anthropic and OpenAI respectively. No separate redistribution license was established; the project's MIT code license does not grant rights to third-party artwork.
